New plan: 

In my previous attempt, I successfully deduced the order of the birds by breaking down the information given and using a step-by-step approach. However, I failed to consider the position of the owl in relation to the other birds. Specifically, I didn't use the fact that the blue jay is to the right of the owl (statement 5) and the raven is to the left of the falcon (statement 6) to determine the correct order.

Next time, I will pay closer attention to the relationships between the birds and use all the given information to deduce the correct order. I will also make sure to consider the position of the owl in relation to the other birds. For example, I will use the fact that the blue jay is to the right of the owl to determine the correct order of the birds before the blue jay.
